snippet.title: Gods With Badges - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Gods with Badges: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4462400

From Strange Scaffold, creators of I Am Your Beast and El Paso, Elsewhere, comes a new narrative tactics game, Gods With Badges. Patrol the open hubs of Scarhelm. Decide the fate of your fellow citizens. Take down criminals in brutal turn-based combat. You are a god with a badge, and when you turn on your bodycam, the only thing you answer to is your conscience and your fellow officers.

Gods with Badges Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4462400

--

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
